comparison.objective: Assemble four cylindrical cells between holder halves in a jig; candidate screens ceramic cylinders from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated keyed cell insertion and final holder alignment versus bulk-particle pouring and orientation-dependent aperture passage.
comparison.success_condition: All cells seated positive-up and holder closed versus ceramic media recovered while washers remain in screen.
comparison.reason: Similar cylindrical geometry is insufficient; the tested abilities are assembly versus granular separation.
